listing_info.listing_name: Studio Design - Unique - Center
listing_info.description:
"Echo of a sweet poetry" appeared as the name of the apartment by observing all the works of art, colors and textures that tell us a story and transport us to a magical place.

Its eclectic design is intended to create a playful and timeless space.

The space
Although it is a studio, this apartment has a natural division that makes each space have its own role.

In the living room-dining room, you will find comfortable leather armchairs and next to them a rustic wooden table with matching high chairs.

In the bedroom, you will have at your disposal a 140 x 190 bed with cozy sheets, colorful blankets, and cushions.

There is a fully equipped kitchen with a coffee maker, kettle, 2-burner induction hob, toaster, microwave, refrigerator, and all the necessary utensils for your meals.

Currently, and considering the high temperatures that have intensified in recent years, an investment has been made to incorporate a wonderful air conditioning system, allowing the space to be enjoyed with maximum comfort and reaffirming the ongoing commitment to always providing the highest level of service and well-being throughout the stay.

Post-scriptum, this studio is located on the third floor, without an elevator.

Other things to note
Of all the beautiful cities in France, it was Bagnères-de-Bigorre that seduced us to take our first steps in the short-term apartment rental service. We wanted to design a range of apartments with personality and at the same time create a different and memorable experience for your stay.

The apartment is located in the heart of Bagnères, it is recommended to take the time to discover this ancient city that holds treasures and medieval vestiges, giving it a unique character and charm.

Just a stone's throw from the Halles, every Saturday the market of Bagnères is a privileged moment for this city, it is the day when all the farmers and artisans of the region exhibit the fruit of their work, and share between laughter and music, the delights of this region.

A 5-minute walk away, you will find the Aquensis baths, the so-called "city of waters." A thermal spa that surprises with the warm architecture of its interior, its idyllic jet areas, its jacuzzis, and its pools. All illuminated in different shades and accompanied by music underwater.

A few steps away, buses take us to "La Mongie," one of the largest ski areas in the French Pyrenees with hundreds of kilometers of slopes of all levels to discover with family or friends. In addition to skiing, you can go sledding, take a torchlit walk, or experience the magical experience of dog sledding.

If you want to know more about the mountain, flora, and fauna of the Pyrenees, you will be 25 minutes by car from the Vertige de l'Adour, in the middle of the wild canyon, where you can enjoy impressive views of the Pic du Midi, go climbing, hiking and picnicking by following the streams. An ideal place to disconnect.

For sports and outdoor enthusiasts, you can enjoy several bike paths and the possibility of rafting, kayaking, golfing, horseback riding, and much more.
